title: Humain to deploy 200 MW of Qualcomm AI200/AI250 racks

sources.quote: Under the new program, HUMAIN plans to install 200 MW of Qualcomm’s AI200 and AI250 rack-scale solutions beginning in 2026.
Starting in 2026, HUMAIN plans to use 200 megawatts of Qualcomm AI200 and AI250 solutions to deliver high-performance AI inference services for businesses and public institutions.

explain: Humain is the first big buyer of Qualcomm's new data-center AI chips, planning 200 megawatts of Qualcomm server racks from 2026 to run AI models for customers. No price was disclosed.
